Irrigant guide

See the trend before it becomes stress

Soil moisture tells you where the field is now. A forward view gives you more time to make the next irrigation decision.

Request a quote →

Soil moisture tells you what the field needs now

It is one of the clearest signals available before you irrigate. It helps separate a field that needs water today from one that still has room to wait.

A forecast gives you time to act

Weather and crop water demand can change the picture quickly. Seeing the direction of soil moisture before the next pass helps you avoid making every decision under pressure.

Know more before the next pass

Irrigant is built to turn field conditions and the near-term forecast into a clearer view of what comes next, without taking the decision away from the grower.
